thread:
jordan_orchidchain: Hey team — onboarding traffic hit a couple spikes and we're seeing p95 around 450-600ms on text-gen. Token spend is higher than expected too, any quick levers we can try? :thinking:

maya_cs: ugh, thanks for flagging. Do you have a representative request + model name? streaming on/off?

jordan_orchidchain: model: redwood-1-standard-v2, stream=true. typical prompt size ~120 tokens, max_tokens=256. sending a sanitized sample:

```json
{"model":"redwood-1-standard-v2","input":"Summarize the following...","max_tokens":256,"stream":true}
```

sam_sre: quick wins: 1) try a compact/int8 model variant for tail requests 2) enable prefix caching for common prompts 3) route non-low-latency traffic to a cheaper model. We can roll a 10% canary to measure quality impact.

liam_ml: agree with Sam. We did an int8 profile that retains top-k behavior for this workload — quality drop was <1.5% on our eval set but cost/latency improved ~30%.

maya_cs: proposed plan: - 48h canary at 10% -> collect latency, token usage, and perf evals on your prompt set - run automated quality evals via our eval harness - if pass, ramp to 50% then full swap. I'll coordinate with you for noise windows.

jordan_orchidchain: sounds good. what's the canary config look like?

sam_sre: sample routing + quant config to drop in the console:

```yaml
routing:
  - percent: 10
    model: redwood-1-compact-int8-v1
  - percent: 90
    model: redwood-1-standard-v2
quantization:
  profile: int8-fast
  kv_cache: enabled
metrics:
  collect: [p95_latency, tokens_per_request, hallucination_rate]
```

maya_cs: I'll open a ticket to capture the eval prompts + success criteria (p95 < 350ms or <10% uplift in hallucination). Jordan, do you have internal SLOs we should map to?

jordan_orchidchain: our target p95 is <400ms and we can't tolerate >5% regression in summary accuracy. If we see >5%, rollback please.

sam_sre: noted — the routing has automatic fallback to standard-v2 if error rate or quality alerts trip. we'll also enable a canary alert in prometheus.

deploy-bot: Canary started: 10% routed to redwood-1-compact-int8-v1. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/canaries/4820001122

maya_cs: next steps for CS: I'll schedule a 30-min sync after 24h to review metrics and decide ramp. tagging @jordan_orchidchain for availability. :calendar:

jordan_orchidchain: available tomorrow 11am PT — thanks all, appreciate the quick turnaround! :rocket:
